patchouli.maid_weapon.contract.name: Contract Fragments
patchouli.maid_weapon.contract.subtitle: Broken records left by the Icebound Witch
$(thing)Contract Blade$() is an addon for Touhou Little Maid. Craft a Contract Blade or a Contract Signing Table, bind one of your tamed maids, and fight together to build resonance and weapon experience.
The table can bind a maid stored in a film to a supported weapon. It also protects contract ownership and prevents an active maid from being lost through unsafe inventory transfers.
patchouli.maid_weapon.entry.growth_value: Contract level ranges from Lv.1 to Lv.10, TLM favorability from 0 to 384, and Contract Resonance from 0 to 200. Only the original owner receives contract levels, favorability rewards, resonance mechanics, and contract damage.$(br2)Legacy contracts default to 200 resonance when first read.

Upgrades use an undefeated challenge chain:$(br)$(bold)Lv.1→2$(): ordinary hostile.$(br)$(bold)Lv.2→3$(): strong monster.$(br)$(bold)Lv.3→4$(): elite monster.$(br)$(bold)Lv.4→5$(): minor boss.$(br2)Unregistered enemies are estimated from maximum health and external boss markers.

$(bold)Lv.5→6$(): Ender Dragon.$(br)$(bold)Lv.6→7$(): Wither.$(br)$(bold)Lv.7→8$(): three recorded kills of each.$(br)$(bold)Lv.8→9$(): at least five combined kills.$(br)$(bold)Lv.9→10$(): at least ten combined kills.$(br2)The owner must complete these kills while holding that contract weapon.

Level bonus is $(thing)B=(level-1)×1$(); Lv.10 gains another 3, giving B=12. Favorability multiplier is $(thing)M=1+0.25×favorability/384$(), ranging from 1 to 1.25: reward only, never a penalty.$(br2)Dedicated damage: $(thing)(3+B)×M$(). Other contract weapons add $(thing)B×M$(). At Lv.10 and full favorability these are 18.75 damage or +15 added damage.

Normal attacks are free. A manifested maid in combat drains 1 resonance every 4 seconds by default; compatibility spells usually cost 2—8. After 5 seconds out of combat, 2 resonance regenerates per second; the Sacred Tree restores 5 per second. Cooperation, food, healing, and shared combat also restore it.$(br2)At zero resonance or near death, the maid recalls for 15 seconds. Lust disables natural regeneration. These frequent actions never alter TLM favorability.
patchouli.maid_weapon.entry.integrations: Goety, Iron's Spells, and Touhou Little Maid: Spell enable compatible ranged magic behavior. SlashBlade and the True POWER addons enable dedicated blade work modes when their APIs are available.
Every integration is optional. Missing or older addons fall back to Contract Blade's built-in behavior instead of preventing the game from loading.
patchouli.maid_weapon.entry.maid_contrac: A maid weapon is not a disposable capture tool. It preserves the contract between maid and player. When deployed again, the maid recovers her appearance, favorability, and owner whenever possible.$(br2)Do not duplicate two weapons containing the same maid data with commands.

Maid weapons grow through combat. TLM favorability begins at Ordinary and only grants a long-term contract damage reward in this mod. Zero favorability is not resentment and never blocks manifestation or causes betrayal.$(br2)Contract Resonance is a 0—200 short-term combat resource used by manifested contract maids.

A contract weapon may be stored by another player or used as an ordinary weapon, but maid bonus damage, favorability, growth, contract sins, and manifestation answer only to the original owner.$(br2)Standalone generic sin inscriptions belong to the weapon and remain transferable. Recall a manifested maid before dropping or transferring her contract weapon.
patchouli.maid_weapon.entry.maid_manifes: Binding a weapon contract with your own TLM maid stores data with a unique identity; it does not clone a second maid. Manifesting restores her appearance, owner, and essential entity data.$(br2)Do not use commands to duplicate two contract items containing the same maid. Both containers would compete for one entity identity.

$(bold)Dedicated maid weapons:$() sneak-use in the air to manifest manually. Normal right-click on the manifested maid opens the TLM backpack; sneak-right-click recalls her.$(br2)$(bold)Other contract weapons:$() manifest after about 0.4 seconds in the main hand and remain for about 1.5 seconds after switching away. Returning to the same contract cancels recall; different contracts hand over in about 0.6 seconds. Maid, Curios, and other container menus pause transitions. Death, logout, and dimension travel still recall immediately.

An automatically manifested maid is recalled if she changes dimension or moves more than 64 blocks from her owner. The contract records her last position and briefly requests nearby chunks when recovery is needed.$(br2)A contract cannot be dropped while its maid remains in the world. Closing a container after moving it also recalls her first.

A manifested ordinary maid keeps the health, armor, equipment, and task attributes of her TLM entity. This mod does not overwrite every maid with one fixed stat block.$(br2)Contract damage in weapon form is separate: dedicated weapons replace the hit value, while other contract weapons add contract damage. See Growth and Values for the formula.

The Contract Binding Table recognizes real SlashBlades and preserves refine, ProudSoul, kill count, SA, model, and texture data. With TLM: True POWER installed, holding a contracted blade selects its registered SlashBlade Attack task; without it, the maid safely falls back to TLM's normal attack.$(br2)ProudSoul, kills, refine, and durability gained or spent by the maid are merged by delta into the original contracted blade held by the player.

Maid Souls and Maid Glories from True POWER belong in the manifested maid's real bauble slots. Recall stores them together with fused NBT, skill cooldowns, rank, and inventory. Their skills continue to use real TLM favorability; Contract Resonance never impersonates favorability.$(br2)Unlimited Blade Works uses other real SlashBlades in the maid inventory. Only the contract's anchor blade is represented by a non-droppable combat projection.
patchouli.maid_weapon.entry.maid_weapons: A blank maid weapon can form a contract with a TLM maid you own. Hold it and right-click your maid to store her appearance, favorability, and essential data.$(br2)Sneak-right-click the air to release her in normal mode. Once bound, only the owner may operate the weapon.
The sword is balanced, while the fast weapon emphasizes speed and mobility. Recipes are shown here and can also be viewed through JEI.
The heavy weapon favors direct pressure. The Contract Binding Table signs, unbinds, and manages weapon contracts. Normal manifestation or recall does not erase weapon level, kills, or embedded sins.
patchouli.maid_weapon.entry.troubleshoot: $(bold)Cannot store a maid:$() verify she is your TLM maid, use the main hand, and check weapon ownership.$(br2)$(bold)Cannot release:$() sneak-right-click the air in normal mode; special blade modes follow their tooltip.$(br2)$(bold)Altar will not start:$() all seven slots require the correct offerings.
If a magic staff or SlashBlade falls back to ordinary attacks, verify that both client and server use matching versions of Contract Blade, TLM, and the optional addon.
